item.description: A powerful and emotional moment unfolded in Stuttgart, Germany, as the Ghana Football Association (GFA) joined Ghanaian business icon Kennedy Agyapong—widely known as Kenpong—in a memorable gathering with the children of the late music legend Daddy Lumba, all in support of the Ghana national football team, the Black Stars, against Germany in a game that ended 2-1 in favor of the hosts.
